responsibility: Implements the region-error note and fallback diagnostic builders used by inference reporting, translating `SubregionOrigin` and concrete or placeholder lifetime failures into structured explanatory notes, region explanations, and trait-bound-copy suggestions attached to emitted diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `infer/note.rs`, this `note.rs` is specific to region/lifetime error reporting: it turns `SubregionOrigin` cases into lifetime-origin notes and builds the concrete or placeholder region-failure diagnostics themselves, including outlives explanations and trait-clause-copy suggestions for impl/trait lifetime mismatches.
